title: How It Works: From Brief to Five Parts | MonoBook
description: How a MonoBook project runs, from your first email to the five parts. One day, seven days or fourteen days.
_approval: Step wording approved by Mehedi 11 Nov 2026. Day-by-day detail stays private; shared in the proposal.

items: You email your brief. Seven things, one email.
We reply within two hours, UK working hours.
We show you what we see. One page, three things we would fix first.
You get a one-page proposal with the options. The work is the same in each. Only the pace changes.
A 30 minute call to start from what you know about your customers.
We do the work at the pace you chose.
blocks._step5Pending: Wording after 'Terms and payment.' is PENDING.

items.text: You send your current logo, a few photos of your van, signs and workwear, and answers to a short brief.
We confirm the brief by a short call or email.
The whole studio works on your project.

items.when: By the end of the day
items.text: You receive all five parts: logo files, colour palette with exact codes, typeface, image style and the guideline document.
Two review points, scheduled around you.
The same work at a slower pace.

blocks.heading: While you wait.
paras: Mehedi replies to every brief himself. Until then, you can see the Mayfair work and read the answers to the questions people ask first.

blocks.heading: Send your brief.
blocks.text: You hear back within two hours, UK working hours.
